title: Tenant egress path simulator and cost-impact timeline for Private console
creator: Ethan Ross
description: Design and prototype a tenant-focused egress path simulator embedded in the Private Console. The feature helps platform and tenant owners visualize likely egress flows (region/peering/VPC endpoint), overlay role-aware access boundaries, and estimate incremental network and inference cost over a selectable time window. Deliver a high-fidelity Figma prototype, a lightweight interactive HTML mock for usability testing, and a spec document that engineers can implement alongside ENG egress-policy APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive prototype shows primary egress paths for a selected tenant, with hoverable segments that reveal estimated bytes/sec and cost-per-hour
Simulator supports time-range playback (1h, 24h, 7d) and displays a cost-impact timeline with stacked contribution by model traffic and egress tier
Role-aware overlay renders access differences for 'admin', 'read-only', and 'platform-ops' personas
Exportable snapshot (PNG + JSON) for attaching to support tickets and runbooks
Design spec includes accessibility notes, tokenized copy for i18n, and a small component library for timeline and path visualizations
comments: 2025-01-13 - Ethan Ross: Initial kickoff; consolidated ask from sales (enterprise regulated customers) and platform teams. PM asked for role-aware view because SOC teams need to triage egress quickly.

2025-01-17 - Sophia Martinez: First draft flows in Figma. Chose a Sankey-lite path to keep layout stable for >20 nodes. Trade-off: Sankey loses exact link latency metadata; added hover cards to surface those metrics instead.

2025-01-21 - Jeremy Li (PM): Requested cost breakdown by model family and by egress tier. Also asked for a compact 'incident snapshot' that support can generate in one click. Added to acceptance criteria.

2025-01-24 - Design review: Feedback from ENG (Anya Bhat) - prefer data-driven rendering vs. deterministic topology for scale. Action: add two rendering modes: 'sampled topology' for quick sim and 'canonical topology' for full accuracy. ENG to provide sample API endpoints (ENG-82111).

2025-01-28 - Usability test round 1 (5 participants): Observations - users wanted clearer differentiation between intra-region egress and cross-region egress. Updated color palette and legend. Lowered cognitive load by collapsing low-impact links under a 'minor paths' toggler.

2025-02-01 - Security review prep: exported asset list and threat model for egress visualization feature. Noted PII risk in tenant identifiers; changed display to tenant initials + hashed id and added mask-by-default policy (security_review_required=true).

2025-02-03 - Sophia Martinez: Updated prototype with playback controls, cost timeline, and export button. Ready for final engineering handoff. Added detailed component tokens and CSS spec to the Confluence page. Posting for design QA and ENG handover next week.
